answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 87 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The relic register is checked at draw time, river lists the eligible set, and comet seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 87 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker forfeits for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 19 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
